edits.hebrew: אָמַר רָבָא: זוֹנָה גּוֹיָה, וְיִשְׂרָאֵל מְסוּבִּין אֶצְלָהּ — חַמְרָא שְׁרֵי, נְהִי דְּתָקֵיף לְהוּ יִצְרָא דַעֲבֵירָה, יִצְרָא דְּיֵין נֶסֶךְ לָא תָּקֵיף לְהוּ.
edits.english: Rava says: In the case of a gentile prostitute, where Jews are dining at her table, the wine at the table is permitted. Granted, the Jews' passion for the sin of prostitution overwhelms the Jews' judgment, and therefore they are with her, but the Jews' passion for wine used for a libation does not overwhelm the Jews' judgment, and the Jews will not allow the gentile prostitute to use it for a libation.

When a gentile prostitute enters a place belonging to an Israelite and containing wine, this wine is permitted, because the gentiles would not allow such a woman to offer wine to idols; but when an Israelite prostitute, who is among gentiles, enters an Israelite's place and touches the wine found there, this wine is forbidden.

Rava says: In the case of a gentile prostitute, where Jews are dining with her — the wine found there is permitted. Granted, their inclination for the sin of prostitution is strong for them, and therefore they are with her, but the inclination for wine used for a libation is not strong for them, and they will not allow the gentile prostitute to pour a libation.

edits.hebrew: זוֹנָה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית וְגוֹיִם מְסוּבִּין — חַמְרָא אָסוּר, מַאי טַעְמָא? הוֹאִיל וְזִילָה עֲלַיְיהוּ, בָּתְרַיְיהוּ גְּרִירָא.
edits.english: In the case of a Jewish prostitute and gentiles dining with her, the wine is forbidden. What is the reason? It is that since the Jewish prostitute is despised in the gentiles' eyes, she is subservient to the gentiles, and the gentiles use the wine for a libation without consideration for her.
The passion for wine for a libation does not overwhelm them - to pour a libation.
She is subjugated to them - that she leaves it to them to pour a libation.

When a gentile prostitute enters a place belonging to an Israelite and containing wine, this wine is permitted, because the gentiles would not allow such a woman to offer wine to idols; but when an Israelite prostitute, who is among gentiles, enters an Israelite's place and touches the wine found there, this wine is forbidden.

But if there was a Jewish prostitute and gentiles dining with her — the wine is forbidden. What is the reason? Since she is despised in their eyes, she is subservient to them, and they use the wine for a libation as they wish without considering her.
